title: Global persistence of nearly radial concentrated vortices in a bounded domain
summary: In this paper, we study the evolution of nearly radial concentrated vortices for the incompressible Euler equation in a bounded planar domain. We prove that if a single vortex is initially concentrated near a strict local minimum point of the Robin function of the domain and is close, up to translation, to its symmetric decreasing rearrangement, then both its shape and location remain uniformly controlled for all time.
